devplans.shows: Bat speed down 2.9 mph in two years (75.4 → 72.5) and sprint speed down 1.2 ft/s, while results stayed elite (.381 wOBA); missed time in 2026
devplans.question: Lost rotational power (hips and trunk), lost lower-body force, or a lingering injury? At 27, a drop this size is not normal aging
devplans.assessment: Medical review of the 2026 injury; force plates (CMJ, IMTP); hip and thoracic rotation ROM; med-ball scoop toss velocity; bat-sensor baseline with his own bat
devplans.block: 12 weeks: restore ROM first, then strength (weeks 1-6), then rotational power and bat-speed intent (weeks 7-12)
devplans.retest: Spring training: bat speed back to 74+ mph, with jump and rotational power at or above baseline

devplans.shows: 2B OAA +19, +6, -9 in three years while sprint speed held at 28.3-28.5 ft/s; top speed is not the problem
devplans.question: First step, lateral change of direction or reaction time (not measured by sprint speed), or positioning
devplans.assessment: 5-10 yd lateral starts and pro-agility (timed), reactive agility drills, lateral force on force plates (L vs R), video of first-step direction on missed plays
devplans.block: Lateral power and deceleration; reactive first-step drills; positioning review with infield coach
devplans.retest: Spring: if lateral tests are below the team infield average, utility role and 2B goes to a better defender

devplans.shows: SS OAA +15, +5, 0; sprint speed 27.6 → 27.1 ft/s; bat speed up to 72.9 mph; multiple IL stints in 2026
devplans.question: A durability and lateral-movement problem at 32, not a bat problem
devplans.assessment: Same lateral battery as Semien; injury history review
devplans.block: Durability (hamstring, adductors, trunk) and lateral power; planned in-season rest schedule
devplans.retest: 600+ PA and SS OAA at 0 or better

devplans.shows: Bat speed down 1.7 mph from 2025 and sprint speed down 1.4 ft/s, with the worst bat on the team (.196 wOBA)
devplans.question: Ankle surgery in Aug 2026: does the ankle explain the lost bat and sprint speed, or is it age?
devplans.assessment: Medical clearance on the ankle, force plates with L vs R comparison, sprint test, bat-sensor baseline
devplans.retest: Spring: a roster spot only if bat speed returns to 71+ mph

devplans.shows: -18 OAA on balls hit in front of fielders (28th) and -26 vs. LHH (29th)
devplans.question: —
devplans.assessment: Monthly review of OAA in front and vs. LHH
devplans.block: Weekly first-step and charging block for every infielder all season; positioning plan vs. LH pull hitters with analytics staff
devplans.retest: Both OAA splits at MLB average

devplans.shows: Sinker 96.6 (2024, reliever) → 93.7 → 93.1 (2025-26, starter); GB still 55% (94th pct); broken leg in May
devplans.question: Has starting cost him power (fatigue, conditioning) beyond the expected drop from relieving?
devplans.assessment: Return-to-play clearance; force plates (L vs R asymmetry after the fracture); velocity by inning and by start
devplans.block: Return-to-run and lower-body strength progression, then throwing ramp; starter conditioning
devplans.retest: Spring: sinker 94+ mph through 5 innings, no limb asymmetry above 10%

devplans.shows: Four-seam 92.2 → 91.3 mph and sweeper whiff 39% → 30% (Savant) in three years; costliest pitch on the 2026 staff
devplans.question: Is the sweeper losing shape (less sweep, slower spin), or are hitters reading it?
devplans.assessment: Pitch-design session with Trackman and high-speed video: sweeper movement and spin vs. 2024; arm-slot consistency
devplans.block: Rebuild the sweeper toward its 2024 shape or cut its use from 30% to about 20%
devplans.retest: Spring bullpens: sweeper whiff back to 33%+ (Savant)

devplans.shows: Four-seam back to 96.3 mph, but whiff fell from 31% to 16% (Savant); walked 14.5%
devplans.question: A release-point or shape change after injury, not a strength problem
devplans.assessment: Release height, extension and fastball movement vs. 2024 (Trackman); delivery video review
devplans.block: Delivery consistency work; command plan by count
devplans.retest: Spring: fastball whiff 22%+ and BB% under 10%
